title: Hardrock Runners Manual 2025
claims: The 2025 runners manual covers 11-13 July 2025 in the counter-clockwise direction.
The 2025 course is approximately 102.5 miles with roughly 33,197 feet of climb and descent.
The 2025 manual lists summer single-lane closures on US 550 between Silverton and Durango and up to 15-minute traffic holds on US 550 between Silverton and Ouray.
